description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Nocturne''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nocturne''' gains a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]] for 1.5 seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, ''Shroud of Darkness' '''''bonus''' attack speed is doubled for 5 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Nocturne gains a spell shield for 1.5 seconds. Upon successfully blocking a hostile effect, Shroud of Darkness' bonus attack speed is doubled for 5 seconds.

leveling2.raw:
'''Enhanced Bonus Attack Speed:'''
60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100%

notes.raw: * If ''Shroud of Darkness'' is active when '''Nocturne''' re-casts ''[[File:Nocturne Paranoia.png|20xpx|border|link=Nocturne#Paranoia|An icon for Nocturne's ability Paranoia]] [[Nocturne#Paranoia|Paranoia]]'' to dash to a target, its duration is refreshed every 0.25 seconds during the dash.
notes.text: If Shroud of Darkness is active when Nocturne re-casts Paranoia to dash to a target, its duration is refreshed every 0.25 seconds during the dash.
